name: DeckCraft v0.8.0
body:
## What's Changed
* Opus: validate the header in Decoder::from_head (#425) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/deckcraft/pull/442
* xtask: assets audit no longer panics on Unicode names and reads real paths from git (#424) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/deckcraft/pull/443
* Info: keep a property draft when another field or the side menu is clicked (#422) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/deckcraft/pull/445
* Engine: moving the selection to another text body settles the composition (#421) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/deckcraft/pull/446
* Format scientific number formats (0.00E+00) in chart labels (#419) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/deckcraft/pull/448
* UI: notes, alt text and rename drafts no longer carry over to another document (#413) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/deckcraft/pull/450
* Pptx: keep the math namespace equations inherit from the slide root or a wrapper (#412) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/deckcraft/pull/451
* MCP: do not resend a command whose reply was lost (#409) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/deckcraft/pull/453
* Engine: a command that fails after editing puts the presentation back (#405) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/deckcraft/pull/454
* Table: split and cell fill stay inside the table (#400) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/deckcraft/pull/455
* Bitstream: reject bad NAL length widths, check NAL endpoints and signed Exp-Golomb limits (#397) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/deckcraft/pull/456
* Matroska: stop following chapter and tag nesting past 32 levels (#396) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/deckcraft/pull/457
* AV1: reject tile groups that repeat, skip or reorder tiles (#395) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/deckcraft/pull/458
* Slide show: Honeycomb's hexagons cover the whole slide again (#420) by @albayazid in https://github.com/storytold/deckcraft/pull/460
* Copy and Cut buttons and menus put the text on the system clipboard (#431) by @Zetenypapp in https://github.com/storytold/deckcraft/pull/463
* Media: preserve video frames and EOF across seeks by @MMexicann in https://github.com/storytold/deckcraft/pull/587
* Fix keyboard navigation when Presenter View has focus by @lambertoo in https://github.com/storytold/deckcraft/pull/707
* Slide show: click-triggered animations, per-slide state and hit testing by @nagasakimark in https://github.com/storytold/deckcraft/pull/713
* pptx: write linked pictures with r:link so PowerPoint resolves external images by @midasmatterhorn in https://github.com/storytold/deckcraft/pull/728
* Colour menus: an Eyedropper that takes a colour from the slide (#367) by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/deckcraft/pull/436
* Slide: leading tabs in a new slide's body set the outline level (#370) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/deckcraft/pull/459
* CLI: convert and run refuse output formats DeckCraft can't write (#715) by @switch87 in https://github.com/storytold/deckcraft/pull/716
* PPTX: .potx and .ppsx declare a template and slide show main part (#210) by @justinjohn0306 in https://github.com/storytold/deckcraft/pull/212
* Animations: nine PowerPoint exit effects import as themselves (#147) by @justinjohn0306 in https://github.com/storytold/deckcraft/pull/222
* SmartArt: text is laid out on its text rectangle (dsp:txXfrm), not in columns by @pierrevbc in https://github.com/storytold/deckcraft/pull/242
* fix: DeckCraft upstream issue #104 by @FabPei in https://github.com/storytold/deckcraft/pull/306
* macOS: end the process in on_exit so closing the window doesn't crash by @marcoarnulfo in https://github.com/storytold/deckcraft/pull/308
* Open: a password-protected presentation says so, and open errors show on the start screen by @marcoarnulfo in https://github.com/storytold/deckcraft/pull/348
* Fonts: the font scan leaves out faces with no outline tables by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/deckcraft/pull/351
* Bump quick-xml to 0.41 (RUSTSEC-2026-0194, RUSTSEC-2026-0195) by @natocool2 in https://github.com/storytold/deckcraft/pull/356
* Fonts: a lookup finds an installed family whichever thread loads it first by @LloydNicholson in https://github.com/storytold/deckcraft/pull/80
* Command palette: one Export… entry that opens the dialog, no path-only duplicate (#79) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/deckcraft/pull/82
* PPTX: animation rewind survives save and reopen (#77) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/deckcraft/pull/83
* Export: an unknown format is an error instead of a deckcraft file by @mikl0s in https://github.com/storytold/deckcraft/pull/95
* Slides: going to a slide that does not exist is an error by @mikl0s in https://github.com/storytold/deckcraft/pull/96
* Commands: an invalid shape id is an error instead of the selection by @mikl0s in https://github.com/storytold/deckcraft/pull/97
* docs(readme): percent-encode middle dot in platforms badge URL by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/deckcraft/pull/98
* PPTX import: a transition without spd is 0.5 s, not the effect's default (#117) by @alexanderalber in https://github.com/storytold/deckcraft/pull/149
* Issue #106: zooming keeps the point under the pointer by @LloydNicholson in https://github.com/storytold/deckcraft/pull/156
* Charts: value axes start above zero when the values sit high, as in Office by @LloydNicholson in https://github.com/storytold/deckcraft/pull/157
* Ribbon: transition and animation tiles follow the dark theme (#159) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/deckcraft/pull/160
* Windows: compile DX12 shaders with FXC by @itrycodinganditsbad in https://github.com/storytold/deckcraft/pull/176
* CLI: --help prints usage and unknown render flags are rejected (#163) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/deckcraft/pull/179
